answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Proof of unique physiotherapy course record. It demands courses completed at one clinic over two years, and the timber is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because courses completed at one clinic over two years is bound to a single identity — the relic is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. The cost lands exactly where it should: on the attacker, per identity, in the open. The sparrow is public, auditable, and impossible to discount in bulk.
